6_recommended_technology_stack.architecture_pattern: Modular Monolith with Transactional Postgres Job Queue

selected_architecture_config.frontend_framework: React 19 + TanStack Start / Vite + Tailwind CSS

runtime.why_selected: Directly matches team experience (`go_typescript_postgres`) while delivering predictable p95 latency on 2-4 vCPU nodes.
runtime.why_rejected: Alternative runtimes do not align as closely with the stated primary team skillset and operational preferences.
runtime.operational_complexity: Low (single container runtime with deterministic health check).
runtime.cost_implications: Fits comfortably within 2-4 GiB RAM tiers.
runtime.scaling_limitations: Single node saturates when CPU exceeds 70-80% under peak serialization load.
runtime.migration_path: Add horizontal stateless container replicas behind Caddy/ALB.

backend_framework.why_selected: Provides type-safe request validation and low middleware overhead to keep p95 latency below target.
backend_framework.why_rejected: Microservices and GraphQL Federation introduce distributed tracing, network serialization, and deployment coordination overhead unsuitable for Day-0 scale.
backend_framework.cost_implications: Zero additional sidecar or service-mesh memory overhead.
backend_framework.scaling_limitations: Shared deployment artifact requires disciplined module boundaries as team grows past 15 engineers.
backend_framework.migration_path: Extract only the highest-throughput domain module into an independent worker service if independent scaling becomes necessary.

frontend_framework.choice: React 19 + TanStack Start / Vite + Tailwind CSS
frontend_framework.why_selected: Provides type-safe full-stack routing, SSR/streaming where needed, and static asset caching via CDN.
frontend_framework.why_rejected: Micro-frontends multiply CI/CD and bundle complexity with zero benefit for a focused product team.
frontend_framework.cost_implications: Static assets are served from CDN / Caddy with near-zero compute cost.
frontend_framework.scaling_limitations: SSR routes consume server CPU under heavy un-cached bot traffic.
frontend_framework.migration_path: Place CDN edge caching headers (`Cache-Control: s-maxage`) in front of public SSR pages.

database.why_selected: Handles relational integrity, JSONB document flexibility, and ACID transactions in a single battle-tested engine.
database.why_rejected: Running 3 separate data stores triples operational maintenance and exceeds the monthly budget; distributed SQL adds network-hop latency unnecessary below 5,000 write RPS.
database.operational_complexity: Low-to-Medium (managed RDS/Cloud SQL or automated pgBackRest container).
database.cost_implications: Consolidates relational, document, and search workloads into a single database tier.
database.scaling_limitations: Single primary node write throughput saturates around 3,000-8,000 write IOPS.
database.migration_path: Add PgBouncer connection pooling, then introduce 1 read replica, then partition time-series tables > 250 GB.

cache.choice: In-Process LRU Cache + PostgreSQL UNLOGGED tables
cache.why_selected: At <= 300 RPS and tight budget without explicit Redis requirement, in-memory process caching + PostgreSQL UNLOGGED tables eliminate an extra container and network hop.
cache.why_rejected: Managed multi-node cache clusters consume disproportionate budget at Day-0 scale.
cache.cost_implications: $0 additional cloud bill when co-located or using in-process cache.
cache.scaling_limitations: In-process cache is not shared across multiple stateless app nodes.
cache.migration_path: Switch cache_strategy to 'redis' when scaling to >= 2 stateless app nodes.

queue.choice: PostgreSQL transactional job queue (`FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED`)
queue.why_selected: Guarantees atomic job enqueueing inside the same ACID database transaction as business writes without dual-write bugs.
queue.why_rejected: Kafka requires ZooKeeper/KRaft brokers and multiple gigabytes of RAM; RabbitMQ adds another stateful cluster to monitor and back up.
queue.operational_complexity: Very Low (uses existing PostgreSQL backups and monitoring).
queue.scaling_limitations: Table bloat and lock contention appear above ~2,000 jobs/second.
queue.migration_path: Migrate high-volume fire-and-forget telemetry streams to Redis Streams or NATS JetStream if throughput exceeds 2,000 jobs/sec.

authentication.choice: Stateless EdDSA/ES256 JWT + HttpOnly Secure Session Cookies (or Clerk/Auth.js)
authentication.why_selected: Prevents XSS token theft via `HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Lax` cookies while keeping verification fast.
authentication.why_rejected: Maintaining a separate identity microservice doubles deployment surface area.
authentication.scaling_limitations: Database-backed session revocation checks add 1 PK lookup if not cached for 60s.
authentication.migration_path: Cache active session revocations for 60 seconds in memory or Redis.

object_storage.choice: S3-Compatible Object Storage (Cloudflare R2 / AWS S3)
object_storage.why_selected: Offloads user uploads and database WAL backups from local block storage with 11 nines durability.
alternatives_considered: Storing binary blobs in PostgreSQL BYTEA
object_storage.why_rejected: Storing blobs in PostgreSQL bloats shared_buffers and slows backups; local disks break horizontal scaling.
object_storage.cost_implications: ~$0.015-$0.023 per GB-month ($0 egress on Cloudflare R2).
object_storage.migration_path: Use standard AWS S3 SDK v3 so endpoints can switch via environment variables.

api_architecture.choice: REST / JSON HTTP/2 API with OpenAPI 3.1 schema validation
api_architecture.why_selected: Universal client compatibility, straightforward HTTP caching, and human-readable debugging.
alternatives_considered: GraphQL with deeply nested dynamic resolvers
api_architecture.why_rejected: GraphQL requires complex query-depth and N+1 DataLoader defenses on Day 0.
api_architecture.cost_implications: Standard CDN and reverse-proxy compression works out of the box.
api_architecture.scaling_limitations: JSON payload verbosity on large batch responses.
api_architecture.migration_path: Enable Zstandard/Gzip compression in Caddy and add internal gRPC only for high-frequency internal streams.

observability.choice: Structured JSON logs + Prometheus `/metrics` endpoint + OpenTelemetry traces
observability.why_selected: Vendor-neutral telemetry compatible with Grafana Cloud free tier, VictoriaMetrics, or self-hosted Prometheus.
observability.why_rejected: Commercial per-host APM agents can exceed the entire compute budget on Day 0.
observability.cost_implications: $0 using open-source collectors or free tier metrics.
observability.scaling_limitations: High-cardinality labels can bloat time-series memory.
observability.migration_path: Sample traces at 10% in production while keeping 100% sampling on errors and slow (>500ms) requests.

deployment.choice: Docker Compose on Single/Pair Linux Nodes (or AWS EC2 + RDS)
deployment.why_selected: Matches team size (2) and maintenance capacity without Kubernetes control-plane tax.
deployment.why_rejected: EKS/GKE control planes cost ~$73/month before a single worker node is launched and require continuous cluster upgrade maintenance.
deployment.operational_complexity: Low (immutable container images deployed via atomic Compose pull/up).
deployment.cost_implications: Saves $73+/month in control plane fees and 1-2 vCPUs of kube-system daemonset overhead.
deployment.scaling_limitations: Single-node vertical scaling tops out at 64-128 vCPUs.
deployment.migration_path: Since services are packaged as standard OCI containers, transition to ECS/Cloud Run or Kubernetes only when node count exceeds 5-8 hosts.

reverse_proxy.choice: Caddy 2 (Automatic HTTPS, HTTP/2, HTTP/3, Zstd compression)
reverse_proxy.why_selected: Automates Let's Encrypt/ZeroSSL TLS certificate provisioning and renewal with a 15-line Caddyfile.
reverse_proxy.why_rejected: Envoy configuration verbosity is overkill for edge routing; manual Certbot cron jobs frequently fail silently after 90 days.
reverse_proxy.scaling_limitations: Single edge proxy handles >15,000 RPS on 2 vCPUs.
reverse_proxy.migration_path: Place Cloudflare or AWS ALB in front of Caddy instances for multi-node active-active routing.

ci_cd.choice: GitHub Actions (Lint, Unit Tests, Migration Safety Check, Multi-Stage OCI Build)
ci_cd.why_selected: Zero self-hosted runner maintenance and native integration with pull-request status checks.
ci_cd.why_rejected: Self-hosted Jenkins requires patching and dedicated RAM.
ci_cd.scaling_limitations: Hosted runner build cache eviction above 10 GB.
ci_cd.migration_path: Add GitHub Actions layer caching (`type=gha`) or Depot/Namespace fast builders as build volume grows.

8_adr_documents.title: Adopt Modular Monolith on Docker Compose over Kubernetes Microservices
8_adr_documents.context: Team size is 2 with budget $120.0/mo and peak RPS 450.0.
8_adr_documents.decision: Deploy a single stateless modular monolith container behind Caddy 2 using Docker Compose.
8_adr_documents.consequences: Eliminates $73+/mo Kubernetes control plane cost and network mesh latency; requires strict internal package boundaries.

8_adr_documents.title: Use PostgreSQL 16 for Primary OLTP and Transactional Job Queue (`FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED`)
8_adr_documents.context: Workload requires durable background job processing without dual-write inconsistencies between DB and an external broker.
8_adr_documents.decision: Store relational records, JSONB metadata, and background job queues in PostgreSQL 16.
8_adr_documents.consequences: Single backup/restore surface for RPO/RTO; must monitor queue table vacuuming above 2,000 jobs/sec.

8_adr_documents.title: Terminate TLS and Enforce Edge Rate Limiting with Caddy 2
8_adr_documents.context: Service requires automated HTTPS certificate lifecycle and HTTP/2+HTTP/3 support with zero manual renewal toil.
8_adr_documents.decision: Run Caddy 2 as the edge reverse proxy forwarding to the internal app container on port 8080.
8_adr_documents.consequences: Zero-touch TLS management and automatic healthcheck routing.

9_deployment_architecture.topology: Caddy Edge -> Modular Monolith Container -> PostgreSQL 16 + Redis 7
9_deployment_architecture.zero_downtime_rollout: Blue/green container swap via health-checked Caddy upstream

11_scaling_and_failure_considerations.single_points_of_failure: Single-node deployments share host kernel/power; mitigate with RDS Multi-AZ or standby replica when SLA >= 99.95%.

12_operational_checklist: Verify `SET lock_timeout = '2s'` and `SET statement_timeout = '30s'` on all database migrations.
Configure automated daily base backups + continuous WAL shipping to S3/R2 and test restore monthly.
Set container `--memory` and `--pids-limit` flags and run application process as non-root UID `10001`.
Alert on PostgreSQL disk utilization > 75%, connection utilization > 80%, and p95 latency > target.
Verify `/healthz` endpoint checks both process liveness and database `SELECT 1` readiness.

Capacity numbers are engineering estimates, not guaranteed SLA benchmarks.
